answers: Large synchronous exports keep users waiting on the request; they need to continue working.
Start an export of selected rows, continue working, then download a CSV containing those originally selected rows in the original column order.
Continuation/download intent and the existing row/column criterion are accepted. A queue/token is only proposed; current export is synchronous and future behavior is unimplemented.
Notifications; no additional duration, performance target or row cap is agreed.
Mira must decide download expiry before implementation, then maintainers choose the mechanism; the expiry value is unknown.
